name: Raptor's Sight
description: Grants a +5 competence bonus on Spot checks; with 5+ ranks in Spot, halves the normal range increment penalty for ranged attacks (-1 per increment instead of -2).

name: Summon Dire Hawk
description: Summons a dire hawk, which appears where designated and acts immediately on the caster's turn; it can be commanded telepathically as a free action.

name: Woodland Veil

targetAreaEffect.value: One or more creatures, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart

description: Makes the targets blend into natural surroundings and muffles the sound they make, granting a +5 competence bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks while outdoors in a natural setting; it has no effect in urban settings or indoors (including dungeons). Affected creatures can still see, hear, and recognize each other and themselves normally, as if unaffected. A target that moves more than 30 feet from another target loses the spell's bonuses.
